name: CEM I mortar interfacial transition zone (ITZ) on one ArBIB-milled surface: stitched SEM-BSE montage (Helios G4 UX, 47104 x 18232 px at 84.31 nm/px), EDX 12-class phase map, uXRF, light and confocal microscopy and a 65 x 20 Berkovich nanoindentation grid, all aligned in QGIS. Data: refodat doi:10.71758/refodat.90 (Kleiner and Li 2026, DFG project 500729359). Descriptor: none found
state: prospective, filled 2026-10-06 (track other_) from repository metadata; nothing downloaded or measured. Source: DataCite https://api.datacite.org/dois/10.71758/refodat.90. The refodat landing page returned a security check, so the file list was not seen. Single specimen: the only series is spatial (distance from the aggregate across the ITZ) plus phase classes.

readers.notes: DataCite formats .tif, .csv, .pdf, .7z (14 files, 7020.67 MB): tifffile (BigTIFF for BSE_High-Res.tif), pandas, py7zr; QGIS alignment packages Full-alignment.7z and NI-EDX-alignment.7z (QGIS); Python Jupyter notebooks for evaluation. Contents of the .7z archives unverified

calibration.notes: Pixel sizes per modality in DataCite: BSE 84.3099 nm/px (3971.3 x 1537.1 um), EDX 288.722 nm/px (1024 x 704 px, 295.7 x 203.3 um), light microscopy 852.778 nm/px, confocal (Keyence VK-X3050) 1372.7 nm/px, uXRF 1148 x 388 px (variable). ArBIB milling 72 h at 6 kV, 2 mA. Nanoindentation tip area function and frame compliance calibration unverified

observables.name: phase area fractions (pores, clinker, portlandite, C-S-H, AFm/AFt and others) from BSE gray levels
observables.notes: Second route: the EDX 12-class phase map on the same aligned region; it ships with the deposit and serves validation only

observables.notes: Position 2 used: 65 x 20 indents over 100 x 325 um (DataCite gives the spacing as 5.0 'nm', which must mean um); position 1 provided but unused; raw load-displacement curves unverified
